Container.Name: Deckle
Container.Overview:
A morning newspaper for your e-reader, built on your server. Deckle sets a real paper from your town's news and weather, your RSS feeds and the articles you saved, with a front page, sections and a puzzle, and has it waiting on your Kindle or KOReader before you're up.
This is the headless container. It builds the Daily on the schedule you set, keeps every edition in a Morgue folder, and delivers it by email to a Kindle (through your own mail account), over Wi-Fi to KOReader, or to any folder. The Deckle app runs in your browser on port 8080 once you set a web UI password; without one, only the schedule runs.
FIRST START: Deckle writes a starter digest.toml in the Config folder. Edit it in the web UI's Daily tab, or edit the file and restart the container. Put the Kindle email password in the Kindle email password field: the container has no keychain.
NOT IN THE CONTAINER: Kindle book conversion (Enhanced Typesetting, X-Ray, Word Wise) needs Kindle Previewer, which only runs on Mac and Windows. Use the desktop app for books.
The web UI speaks plain HTTP. Beyond your home network, put it behind a reverse proxy with TLS. Setup: https://github.com/CasaVargas/deckle/blob/main/docs/docker.md
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: newspaper news rss feeds kindle koreader kobo e-reader eink epub digest morning paper read-later
Container.Requires: Internet access to fetch the news, weather and feeds. To reach a Kindle: an email account Deckle can send from, with that address on Amazon's approved list.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: digest.toml, papers and state. Small; keep it on appdata.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: The Morgue, library, Inbox, uploads and export folders (Deckle/ inside).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id the files are written as (99 is nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id the files are written as (100 is users).

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone. Papers print on this zone's clock.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: The Deckle app in your browser.

Config.Name: Web UI password
Config.Description: The password the web UI asks for; 12 or more characters. Without one the web UI stays off and only the schedule runs.

Config.Name: Kindle email password
Config.Description: Password for the [email] account that sends the paper to your Kindle. Leave blank if you don't email it.

Config.Name: Bookmarklet port
Config.Description: Optional. Lets a browser bookmarklet save pages to tomorrow's paper.

Config.Name: Bookmarklet address
Config.Description: Optional. The address your browser reaches the bookmarklet port at, as scheme://host[:port] with no path, e.g. http://tower.local:47219.

Config.Name: KOReader over Wi-Fi port
Config.Description: Optional. The reader server: the paper and your books in KOReader's catalog, and its sync. Off until you turn it on in the Daily tab's Delivery.

Config.Name: KOReader over Wi-Fi address
Config.Description: Optional. The address your e-readers reach that port at, e.g. http://tower.local:47220, so the app shows URLs that work.

Config.Name: KOReader calibre port
Config.Description: Optional. KOReader's calibre connection. Readers find it by themselves only with Network Type: host.
